proved: If H,V and source bank G are mutually independent, f_H<=K_H, f_V<=K_V, T=T(G) has density cap K_T, R=R(G) is arbitrary measurable, and t*lambda!=0, then Q=2tHT+R+lambda V^2+gamma V+c has a bounded continuous density with ||p_Q||_inf <= 6(K_H K_T K_V)^(2/3)|t|^(-2/3)|lambda|^(-1/3).
For a cap-K variable V, ||p_(lambda V^2+gamma V)||_(3/2) <= 2 K^(2/3)|lambda|^(-1/3), proved by exact layer cake E|V|^(-1/2)<=2sqrt(2K) plus scaling.

For every finite-measure Borel A and shell r<=|T|<=2r, the support-separated curved trace satisfies P(R/(2tT)+(lambda V^2+gamma V)/(2tT) in A) <= 8 K_T K_V sqrt(|t|/|lambda|) r^(3/2)sqrt(|A|), uniformly in arbitrary same-bank R, hence also arbitrary affine shear.

The exact target-valid family Q_epsilon=2HL+2epsilon LP+V^2 is bounded uniformly in epsilon whenever V is carried by an independent source bank; with H physical and unit L,V projections of disjoint cap-one banks, ||p||_inf<9.525.
